batch: Shanghai closeout and Beijing core attractions source review
scope: Selected descriptive and visitor-information claims checked against municipal official sources. This is not a live ticket availability check or a complete operational verification.

records.name: Former French Concession
claimsReviewed: Shanghai municipal city-walk guidance identifies routes through historic streets in Xuhui and Huangpu, including Wukang Road, Sinan Road, Julu Road, Taikang Road and Xintiandi
Official route content supports treating these streets and attractions as visitor walk areas; it does not establish a single definitive boundary for the Former French Concession
records.source: Shanghai Municipal Government English portal — Urban Discovery city-walk routes; historical Jing'an route
records.notes: Area-level destination. Do not display a single precise boundary or entrance as official. Route coverage is source-supported; boundaries and visitor entry points remain unverified.

records.name: Wukang Road
claimsReviewed: Located in Xuhui district
Official description highlights historic architecture and cultural heritage
Wukang Road Tourist Information Centre is listed at No. 393-A Wukang Road
records.notes: Claims reviewed are descriptive/location-related. Current opening hours and attraction-specific access not verified.

records.name: Tianzifang
claimsReviewed: Located at Alley 210, Taikang Road, Huangpu district
Official source lists general area as open 24/7 and free admission
Area contains historic lane housing and varied architectural styles
records.source: Huangpu District government via Shanghai Municipal Government English portal
records.notes: General district access only; individual businesses and venues have their own hours and policies.

records.name: Xintiandi
claimsReviewed: Shikumen heritage block
Official source describes restoration and mixed cultural, lifestyle, dining and fashion functions
records.notes: Descriptive heritage claims reviewed; current individual venue hours and prices not verified.

records.name: Palace Museum / Forbidden City
claimsReviewed: Official Beijing portal provides address and seasonal opening/last-entry details
Official source says advance reservation is required and Monday closure applies except public holidays
Palace Museum is the former imperial palace of Ming and Qing dynasties
records.notes: Operational details are dynamic and should be rechecked before travel. The current page's cited details were reviewed; this record is not a live availability check.

records.name: Great Wall (Badaling section)
claimsReviewed: Beijing official attraction guide locates Badaling in Yanqing District, northwest of Beijing
Official ticketing guide provides seasonal visitor information and ticketing guidance for Badaling
records.notes: This review is specifically about Badaling and must not be generalized to every Great Wall section. Dynamic access and ticket details require rechecking.

records.name: Temple of Heaven
claimsReviewed: Official source describes the complex as the imperial ritual site for worship of Heaven and prayers for harvest
Official central-axis guide provides seasonal park hours, address and published ticket prices
records.notes: Park and separately ticketed scenic areas have different access/ticket details. Dynamic rules should be rechecked.

records.name: Summer Palace
claimsReviewed: Official Beijing guide describes the imperial garden and landscape integration
Municipal ticketing guide provides park hours and separately charged attraction access information
records.notes: Seasonal hours, separate attractions and ticket prices are dynamic; recheck before travel.

records.name: Tian'anmen Square
claimsReviewed: Official Beijing attraction guide places the square in central Beijing along East Chang'an Avenue
Official holiday guide lists square access hours and reservation channels
records.notes: Reservation channels and security/access rules are dynamic; recheck before travel.

records.name: Jingshan Park
records.notes: Official pages appear to provide inconsistent reservation guidance for foreign visitors; this batch does not resolve the discrepancy. Confirm directly before visiting.
